description:
Comfort Music | Healing Music with Sarangi | 1 Hour

The Sarangi is the closest an instrument has ever come to the human voice. Its strings are bowed, not plucked — so they breathe. They sigh. They hold a note the way a singer would, with the same small trembles, the same pauses. For centuries it has been the instrument Hindustani classical tradition turns to when nothing else can reach the place that hurts.

This hour is built around the Sarangi in Raga Bhairavi — the deep, undefended raga traditionally played at the very end of the night, when the music has nothing left to prove. Layered with 432Hz tuning and a 6Hz Theta carrier, it's designed to do what Sarangi has always done best: meet the busy mind quietly and let it settle.

🌿 What you'll hear:
• Sarangi solo in Raga Bhairavi (the closing healing raga of Hindustani tradition)
• Tanpura drone background (steady tonal anchor)
• 432Hz tuning · 6Hz Theta wave entrainment

🌿 Chapters:
00:00 — Sarangi enters slowly
15:00 — Open the bowed phrases
30:00 — Sustained holding
45:00 — Quiet close

🌿 How to use:
Late evenings · before bed · when the mind keeps replaying things · while reading · for emotional release that doesn't need words

🌿 Best for:
A mind that won't settle · slow heartbreak healing · post-difficult-day decompression · meditation practice · journaling sessions

If the room felt a little quieter — subscribe. Music for the long evenings.
